claims.claim: All Hyundai and kia genuine spare parts and accessories are available both new and fairly used...
claims.evidence: Witness report only shows a car headlight assembly; no brand/model compatibility, part number, or proof of “genuine” status.

risks.risk: Fitment/compatibility risk (Hyundai/Kia specific vs generic; exact side and model not confirmed).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the headlight part number/label (or VIN/vehicle model compatibility chart) and a shot showing left/right marking and mounting pattern.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic used headlight assembly with uncertain fitment (worst-case compatibility).

risks.risk: Non-working risk (bulbs/holders/igniter/ballast condition not tested; internal components may be dead).
risks.proof: A short video showing the headlight powered on (low/high beam and amber indicator) or a test with working bulbs/continuity check.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not guaranteed working (worst-case: bulbs/holders may need replacement).

risks.risk: Lens damage or moisture ingress risk (cracks/chips/clouding or water inside may not be fully visible in the single laid-on-ground shot).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the lens surface from multiple angles plus a check for condensation/moisture inside the housing.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged/uncertain cosmetic condition (worst-case: lens/housing may be compromised).

risks.risk: Missing or incomplete assembly risk (not shown whether all bulbs/covers/internal parts are included).
risks.proof: A photo inventory showing all included components (bulbs/holders/covers/adjuster parts) and the back housing/connector area.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/unknown completeness (worst-case: missing internal parts).

risks.risk: Mounting and sealing risk (tabs/brackets, wiring connectors, and rubber gaskets/seals may be broken or degraded).
risks.proof: Photos of mounting tabs/brackets, connector condition, and rubber seals/gaskets around the perimeter.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as needing mounting/seal/wiring attention (worst-case: may require repairs).

proof_requests: Send a clear close-up of any part number/label on the headlight lens/housing (and left/right marking).
Show a video of the headlight and amber indicator working (low/high beam if applicable).
Provide close-up photos of the lens for cracks/chips and the inside for moisture/condensation.
Show the back side: connectors, wiring ports, and rubber seals/gaskets around the housing.
Confirm completeness: list and show all included bulbs/covers/internal parts.
response.reason: The witness can identify it as a car headlight assembly, so it can be priced at its worst-case used condition. However, Hyundai/Kia “genuine” and exact fitment/working status are not proven from the report, so the price should assume uncertainty until the requested proof is provided.
